answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake that grows with the value it moves, verified through a prism of independent checks: proof of unique hardware, a history of useful work, and peer attestations. A sybil swarm can fake one signal, but forging all three at scale costs more than any single identity could earn, so attackers stay at the nadir of profitability while honest agents climb toward the zenith of trust and reward.
